campus: Take S-Bahn line S2 to S Buch.
From S Buch, take bus 353 to Campus Buch; the stop is directly by the conference venue.
Bus lines 150, 158 and 259 also serve stops near the campus.
Use the live BVG or VBB journey planner on the day, because construction and timetable changes can occur.
berlin: One ticket covers S-Bahn, U-Bahn, tram, bus and ferry services within the selected Berlin fare zones.
Berlin-Buch lies in fare zones A/B. BER Airport is in zone C, so airport journeys to or from Berlin require an ABC ticket.
Validate paper tickets before travelling. Digital tickets must be activated before the journey if activation is not automatic.
Use the live BVG or VBB journey planner on the day because construction and timetable changes can occur.
airport: BER Airport railway station is below Terminal 1 on level U2.
Regional trains and the Airport Express connect BER with central Berlin; S-Bahn services also operate from the airport.
For the conference, plan a live route to “Campus Buch” and allow additional transfer time.

meetingInfo.poster: Maximum poster size: 120 cm high × 100 cm wide. Wider formats cannot be accepted.
meetingInfo.talks: Keynotes: 30 min talk + 10 min discussion. Oral presentations: 15 min talk + 5 min discussion, unless otherwise scheduled.
meetingInfo.cme: Recognition by the Berlin Medical Association has been requested for 2026. Physicians seeking credit should bring their barcode labels; final confirmation remains subject to approval.
meetingInfo.onsite: On-site registration is listed as available on the official meeting page.
meetingInfo.language: The official meeting language is English.
meetingInfo.abstracts: The app contains 74 submitted abstracts. One source PDF contains title, authors and affiliation only, without an abstract body.

privacy.summary: The app stores favourites, theme choice and installation preferences only on the participant’s device. It has no login, advertising, analytics, attendee tracking, location collection or payment data.
